raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to disambiguate George Albert Smith (the film director) from George Albert Smith (the LDS Church leader) when conducting searches. This error introduced irrelevant results into the task, conflating information about a religious leader with that of the filmmaker, thereby delaying systematic resolution. The failure to refine search queries early in the process led to confusion, with repeated mismatches of target sources and slower convergence toward credible biographical confirmation.
